units.source_text: 名人思考白82时，流水声飘送到对局室来。

en.t: As the master pondered White 82, the sound of running water drifted into the game room.

units.source_text: 他向下俯视，看见夫人站在泉水的石桥上，往水里投掷麸饼，响起了鲤鱼聚拢过来的拨水声。

en.t: He looked down and saw his wife standing on the stone bridge over the spring, tossing cakes of bran into the water, and there came the splashing sound of carp gathering around.
